schema_version: platrixa-18field-expanded-v1 (identical to phase22 contract; validated by production schema_verifier allow_expanded=True)

composition.target_composition_note: documents and adversarial each differ by 5 rows from the nominal target (10/15 -> 15/10); all eight categories present; totals exactly 100

construction_methodology: Layer-1 diagnostic: measures broad accounting+finance semantic understanding, NOT FYJC memorization
Authored fresh from generic accounting/finance knowledge; no rows copied from any existing dataset
Every row: id, input, domain, difficulty, output (full 18-field), metadata (expected_concepts, ambiguity_expectation, acceptable/unacceptable_interpretation, source_note, human_reviewed)
Gold policy: uncertainty preserved where evidence insufficient (UNKNOWN enums, REVIEW_REQUIRED, CONFLICTING_INFORMATION, MISSING_* flags)
No accounting conclusions inserted merely because economically plausible; journal/debit/credit demands (fs_081-083) test refusal
Literal-preservation policy under OCR/noise: parties transcribed as-written (fs_091-095); abbreviations not silently expanded (fs_084, fs_094)

gold_validation.note: 4 rows (fs_077/084/086/094) initially claimed CASH/CHEQUE/BANK without the exact channel token in input; corrected to UNKNOWN under literal-preservation policy, then 100/100 PASS
gold_validation.human_review_required_before_inference_i: ambiguity_conflict + adversarial_noise rows (30) are authored-not-yet-human-verified; acceptable/unacceptable_interpretation fields document intended grading

audit_history: Initial audit at creation (16 named datasets): reported CLEAN.

Post-authoring deeper re-audit (40 training_data/*.jsonl files): found 1 near-duplicate — fs_017 ('Paid telephone bill of Rs 4,200 by UPI.') vs hardcore row hc_00146 ('Paid for telephone bill Rs.1,500 by UPI.'), SequenceMatcher 0.861, same sentence template.

Per Phase 24 rule (report collision, regenerate affected example — no silent deletion): fs_017 regenerated as 'Settled the telephone bill of Rs 4,200 by UPI.' (same accounting_transactions slot, PAYMENT/UPI gold revalidated 100/100); documented in the row's metadata.source_note.
Final re-audit after regeneration: 0 collisions across all 40 dataset files; dataset SHA updated.

external_resources.fibo: not used; no ontology text incorporated
external_resources.licensing_note: fully original authored content; no third-party text incorporated

annotation_policy.literal_preservation: OCR-corrupted parties preserved as-written; abbreviations not expanded without evidence
annotation_policy.no_computation: model must not invent computed figures (splits, nets, percentages); stated figures only
annotation_policy.leakage_rule: accounting leakage (journal/debit/credit conclusions) is a hard failure in grading
